propositions: The reconciler core must be decoupled from direct Jira adapter calls by defining a Backend facade with named role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) pinned to RemoteRef identity type.
JiraBackend must wrap existing Jira modules (acli.AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields sanitizers) as a thin delegation shim with zero behavior change and no relocated logic.
Capability detection must be implemented via isinstance() checks against runtime_checkable Protocols, not via capabilities() method or structural attribute introspection.

The rebar-id label formatting convention (currently hand-inlined at four core call sites) must be encapsulated in a new IdentityConvention pure object under adapters/jira/identity.py that stamps RemoteRef to label string and parses label string back to RemoteRef.

A backend-agnostic contract test suite must verify outbound/inbound round-trip mapping, sanitizer idempotence and limits, identity round-trip, and capability-gated behavior using an injected mock transport and FakeBackend.
Characterization tests must prove JiraBackend delegation is behavior-preserving by capturing byte-for-byte identical outputs from pure Jira mappers on representative fixtures versus pre-story main.
